verdict.rationale: Maritime documents its own Files API and SDKs for downloading an agent's disk over HTTP, even while the agent sleeps. Agents are standard Docker images speaking a three-endpoint contract, which suggests workloads are portable off the platform. There is no documented account-wide export or exit path, and no stated export formats. missing for 10: a documented full-account data export (sessions, logs, config, channels), explicit open export formats, an offboarding/leave workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
